sources.title: Playwright — Node.js library to automate Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
sources.keyClaim: 81k+ stars, highest-level CDP abstraction, used by Google itself. Provides auto-wait, locator-based selectors, multi-target coordination. Overkill for single-tab agent scenarios.

sources.title: Puppeteer — Node.js library for Chrome DevTools Protocol
sources.keyClaim: 91k+ stars, CDP-focused, best for page-level scripting. More direct than Playwright but still adds abstraction layer.

sources.title: chrome-remote-interface — Chrome DevTools Protocol JavaScript API
sources.keyClaim: 2.8k stars, low-level CDP bindings. Thin wrapper over raw WebSocket. Good for direct protocol work.

sources.title: cdp — Go package for Chrome DevTools Protocol
sources.keyClaim: 601 stars, Go, type-safe CDP client. Language-agnostic patterns for CDP automation.

sources.title: cdp — TypeScript type-safe Chrome DevTools Protocol bindings
sources.keyClaim: 766 stars, TypeScript, type-safe CDP bindings. Direct protocol access without abstraction overhead.

sources.title: eventsource-parser — Parse EventSource streams in the browser and Node.js
sources.keyClaim: 484 stars, 0 deps, browser+node, createParser() returns iterator. MIT, widely used (788 dependents). Spec-compliant SSE parser.

sources.title: parse-sse — A spec compliant server sent events parser
sources.keyClaim: Lightweight, spec-compliant, works with native Fetch API. Returns ReadableStream. Good for streaming response parsing.

sources.title: better-sse — Dead simple, dependency-free server-sent events library
sources.keyClaim: 829 stars, server-side SSE, TypeScript. Full-featured SSE server library.

sources.title: sse-stream-parser — Parse an SSE stream from a ReadableStream
sources.keyClaim: TypeScript, ReadableStream to structured data. Good for browser and Node.js streaming.

sources.title: pybatchexecute — Python library for Google Batchexecute RPC
sources.keyClaim: Python, Google batch RPC encoding/decoding, based on Ryan Kovatch research. Handles XSSI prefix stripping and batch response parsing.

sources.title: go-notebooklm — Go batchexecute client with encoding package
sources.keyClaim: Go batchexecute client with encoding package. Handles batch RPC request/response format.

sources.title: batchexecute — Go batchexecute RPC with default and compressed response format
sources.keyClaim: Go, RPC request/response with default and compressed response format handling. XSSI prefix detection and stripping.

sources.title: agent-browser-withCDPnetworkcapture — CDP network capture CLI for AI agents
sources.keyClaim: CDP network capture CLI for AI agents, with route interception. Captures network traffic for agent analysis.

sources.title: Vercel AI SDK v5 — streamText() with pipeDataStreamToResponse()
sources.keyClaim: Protocol-level streaming API. pipeDataStreamToResponse(), pipeUIMessageStreamToResponse(). Standard streaming protocol for AI agents.

sources.title: OpenAI Agents SDK — StreamableHTTP transport, stateful mode
sources.keyClaim: Uses StreamableHTTP transport, stateful mode. Protocol-level streaming for agent communication.

sources.title: eventsource-lite — Minimal EventSource for client-side streaming
sources.keyClaim: Minimal EventSource for client-side streaming. Lightweight SSE client implementation.
